fields.Name: T246 - Collections Tab Full View
fields.Description: Exercises the activeTab='collections' branch that replaces the sidebar+chat with CollectionsFullViewComponent (Finder-style breadcrumb + view toggle) — a distinct top-level view.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the Chat application and wait for the workspace. Click the 'Collections' tab in the top navigation. Confirm the main area switches to the collections full view: a breadcrumb starting at 'Collections' (home), a grid/list view-mode toggle button, and either collection/artifact cards or a valid empty state. Optionally click the view-mode toggle and confirm the layout switches between grid and list. Seeing the collections view render with its breadcrumb and controls is success regardless of how many collections exist. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Collections tab swaps the main area to the collections full view with a 'Collections' breadcrumb/home
A grid/list view-mode toggle (and/or select-mode, sort controls) is present
Collection/artifact content renders OR a valid empty state is shown
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
